 │     95     def _analyze_api_file(self, file_path: Path) -> List[APIEndpoint]:                                                                                                                                │
 │     96         """Analyze an API file to extract endpoint information."""                                                                                                                                    │
 │     97         endpoints = []                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │     98         try:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │     99             content = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                           │
 │    100             tree = ast.parse(content)                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    101                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    102             # Look for endpoint decorators                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    103             for node in ast.walk(tree):                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    104                 if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    105                     # Check for FastAPI decorators                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    106                     for decorator in node.decorator_list:                                                                                                                                             │
 │    107                         if isinstance(decorator, ast.Call) and hasattr(decorator.func, 'attr'):                                                                                                       │
 │    108                             method = decorator.func.attr                                                                                                                                              │
 │    109                             if method in ['get', 'post', 'put', 'delete']:                                                                                                                            │
 │    110                                 # Extract path from decorator                                                                                                                                         │
 │    111                                 if decorator.args:                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    112                                     path_arg = decorator.args[0]                                                                                                                                      │
 │    113                                     if isinstance(path_arg, ast.Constant):                                                                                                                            │
 │    114                                         path = path_arg.value                                                                                                                                         │
 │    115                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    116                                         # Extract parameters                                                                                                                                          │
 │    117                                         parameters = self._extract_function_parameters(node)                                                                                                          │
 │    118                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    119                                         # Try to extract response schema from return type annotation                                                                                                  │
 │    120                                         response_schema = self._extract_response_schema(node)                                                                                                         │
 │    121                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    122                                         endpoints.append(APIEndpoint(                                                                                                                                 │
 │    123                                             method=method.upper(),                                                                                                                                    │
 │    124                                             path=path,                                                                                                                                                │
 │    125                                             function_name=node.name,                                                                                                                                  │
 │    126                                             parameters=parameters,                                                                                                                                    │
 │    127                                             response_schema=response_schema,                                                                                                                          │
 │    128                                             file_path=str(file_path.relative_to(self.project_root)),                                                                                                  │
 │    129                                             line_number=decorator.lineno                                                                                                                              │
 │    130                                         ))                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    131         except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    132             pass                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    133                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    134         return endpoints                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    135                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    136     def _extract_function_parameters(self, func_node: ast.FunctionDef) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:                                                                                                       │
 │    137         """Extract parameters from a function definition."""                                                                                                                                          │
 │    138         parameters = []                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    139         for arg in func_node.args.args:                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    140             param_info = {                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    141                 "name": arg.arg,                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    142                 "annotation": None,                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    143                 "default": None                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    144             }                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    145                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    146             # Extract type annotation                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    147             if arg.annotation:                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    148                 param_info["annotation"] = ast.unparse(arg.annotation)                                                                                                                                │
 │    149                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    150             parameters.append(param_info)                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    151                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    152         return parameters                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    153                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    154     def _extract_response_schema(self, func_node: ast.FunctionDef) -> Dict[str, Any]:                                                                                                                 │
 │    155         """Extract response schema from function return annotation."""                                                                                                                                │
 │    156         if func_node.returns:                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    157             try:                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    158                 return {"return_type": ast.unparse(func_node.returns)}                                                                                                                                │
 │    159             except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    160                 pass                                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    161         return {}                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    162                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    163     def _extract_ui_components(self) -> List[UIComponent]:                                                                                                                                            │
 │    164         """Extract UI components that consume APIs."""                                                                                                                                                │
 │    165         components = []                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    166                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    167         # Find all .tsx files in webapp/src                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    168         for file_path in self.webapp_src.rglob("*.tsx"):                                                                                                                                              │
 │    169             if file_path.is_file():                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    170                 try:                                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    171                     component_info = self._analyze_ui_component(file_path)                                                                                                                            │
 │    172                     if component_info:                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    173                         components.append(component_info)                                                                                                                                             │
 │    174                 except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    175                     continue                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    176                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    177         return components                                                                                                                                                                             │

 │    179     def _analyze_ui_component(self, file_path: Path) -> Optional[UIComponent]:                                                                                                                        │
 │    180         """Analyze a UI component to extract API consumption."""                                                                                                                                      │
 │    181         try:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    182             content = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                           │
 │    183                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    184             # Extract component name                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    185             name = file_path.stem                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    186                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    187             # Extract API calls (fetch, axios, apiGet, etc.)                                                                                                                                          │
 │    188             api_calls = self._extract_api_calls(content)                                                                                                                                              │
 │    189                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    190             # Extract props                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    191             props = self._extract_component_props(content)                                                                                                                                            │
 │    192                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    193             # Extract state variables                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    194             state_vars = self._extract_state_variables(content)                                                                                                                                       │
 │    195                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    196             return UIComponent(                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    197                 name=name,                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    198                 file_path=str(file_path.relative_to(self.project_root)),                                                                                                                              │
 │    199                 api_calls=api_calls,                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    200                 props=props,                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    201                 state_vars=state_vars                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    202             )                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    203         except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    204             return None                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    205                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    206     def _extract_api_calls(self, content: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:                                                                                                                               │
 │    207         """Extract API calls from component content."""                                                                                                                                               │
 │    208         api_calls = []                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    209                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    210         # Common API call patterns                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    211         patterns = [                                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    212             (r'apiGet\(["\']([^"\']+)', 'GET'),                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    213             (r'apiPost\(["\']([^"\']+)', 'POST'),                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    214             (r'fetch\(["\']([^"\']+)', 'FETCH'),                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    215             (r'axios\.(get|post|put|delete)\(["\']([^"\']+)', 'AXIOS'),                                                                                                                               │
 │    216         ]                                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    217                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    218         import re                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    219         for pattern, method in patterns:                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    220             matches = re.findall(pattern, content)                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    221             for match in matches:                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    222                 if isinstance(match, tuple):                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    223                     # Axios pattern with method                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    224                     path = match[1] if len(match) > 1 else match[0]                                                                                                                                   │
 │    225                     api_calls.append({                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    226                         "method": method,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    227                         "path": path,                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    228                         "type": "detected"                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    229                     })                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    230                 else:                                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    231                     # Simple pattern                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    232                     api_calls.append({                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    233                         "method": method,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    234                         "path": match,                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    235                         "type": "detected"                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    236                     })                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    237                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    238         return api_calls                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    239                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    240     def _extract_component_props(self, content: str) -> List[str]:                                                                                                                                    │
 │    241         """Extract component props from content."""                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    242         props = []                                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    243                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    244         # Look for common prop patterns                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    245         if 'interface Props' in content:                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    246             # TypeScript interface                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    247             lines = content.split('\n')                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    248             in_interface = False                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    249             for line in lines:                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    250                 if 'interface Props' in line:                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    251                     in_interface = True                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    252                     continue                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    253                 if in_interface:                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    254                     if line.strip().startswith('}'):                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    255                         break                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    256                     if ':' in line:                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    257                         prop_name = line.split(':')[0].strip()                                                                                                                                        │
 │    258                         if prop_name and prop_name.isidentifier():                                                                                                                                    │
 │    259                             props.append(prop_name)                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    260                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    261         return list(set(props))                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    262                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    263     def _extract_state_variables(self, content: str) -> List[str]:                                                                                                                                    │
 │    264         """Extract state variables from component content."""                                                                                                                                         │
 │    265         state_vars = []                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    266                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    267         # Look for useState hooks                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    268         import re                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    269         state_matches = re.findall(r'useState\(([^)]*)\)', content)                                                                                                                                   │
 │    270         for match in state_matches:                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    271             state_vars.append(f"state_{len(state_vars)}")                                                                                                                                             │
 │    272                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    273         return state_vars                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    274                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    275     def _check_contract_violations(self, ui_components: List[UIComponent],                                                                                                                            │
 │    276                                  api_endpoints: List[APIEndpoint]) -> List[ContractViolation]:                                                                                                        │
 │    277         """Check for contract violations between UI and API."""                                                                                                                                       │
 │    278         violations = []                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    279                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    280         # Create endpoint lookup by path                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    281         endpoint_lookup = {endpoint.path: endpoint for endpoint in api_endpoints}                                                                                                                     │
 │    282                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    283         # Check each UI component                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    284         for component in ui_components:                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    285             for api_call in component.api_calls:                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    286                 path = api_call.get("path", "")                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    287                 if path in endpoint_lookup:                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    288                     # Endpoint exists, check parameters and response                                                                                                                                  │
 │    289                     endpoint = endpoint_lookup[path]                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    290                     # TODO: Add detailed parameter/response checking                                                                                                                                  │
 │    291                     pass                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    292                 else:                                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    293                     # Missing endpoint                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    294                     violations.append(ContractViolation(                                                                                                                                              │
 │    295                         type="missing_endpoint",                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    296                         ui_component=component.name,                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    297                         api_endpoint=path,                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    298                         details=f"UI component '{component.name}' calls API endpoint '{path}' which doesn't exist",                                                                                   │
 │    299                         severity="critical"                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    300                     ))                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    301                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    302         return violations                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    303                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    304     def _get_current_timestamp(self) -> str:                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    305         """Get current timestamp in ISO format."""                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    306         from datetime import datetime, timezone                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    307         return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    308                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    309     def generate_contract_report(self, report: ContractReport) -> str:                                                                                                                                │
 │    310         """Generate a human-readable contract report."""                                                                                                                                              │
 │    311         output = []                                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    312         output.append("# Contract Verification Report")                                                                                                                                               │
 │    313         output.append(f"Generated: {report.timestamp}")                                                                                                                                               │
 │    314         output.append(f"Components Analyzed: {report.components_analyzed}")                                                                                                                           │
 │    315         output.append(f"Endpoints Covered: {report.endpoints_covered}")                                                                                                                               │
 │    316         output.append("")                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    317                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    318         if report.violations:                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    319             output.append("## Contract Violations")                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    320             output.append("")                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    321                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    322             # Group by severity                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    323             severity_order = {"critical": 0, "high": 1, "medium": 2, "low": 3}                                                                                                                        │
 │    324             sorted_violations = sorted(report.violations, key=lambda v: severity_order.get(v.severity, 999))                                                                                          │
 │    325                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    326             for violation in sorted_violations:                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    327                 output.append(f"### {violation.severity.upper()}: {violation.type}")                                                                                                                  │
 │    328                 output.append(f"- **Component**: {violation.ui_component}")                                                                                                                           │
 │    329                 output.append(f"- **Endpoint**: {violation.api_endpoint}")                                                                                                                            │
 │    330                 output.append(f"- **Details**: {violation.details}")                                                                                                                                  │
 │    331                 output.append("")                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    332         else:                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    333             output.append("## ✅ No Contract Violations Found")                                                                                                                                       │
 │    334             output.append("All UI components are properly aligned with API contracts.")                                                                                                               │
 │    335                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    336         return "\n".join(output)                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    337                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    338                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    339 def create_contract_guardian(project_root: str = ".") -> ContractGuardian:                                                                                                                            │
 │    340     """Factory function to create a ContractGuardian instance."""                                                                                                                                     │
 │    341     return ContractGuardian(project_root)                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    342                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    343                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    344 # Example usage:                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    345 if __name__ == "__main__":                                                                                                                                                                            │

 │    353                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    354     # Save report                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    355     report_file = Path("data/contract_report.md")                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    356     report_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                                                                                                                                             │
 │    357     report_file.write_text(report_text, encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                             │
 │    358     print(f"\nReport saved to: {report_file}")                                                                                                                                                        │
