 │    111     def _create_backup(self, file_path: Path, content: str) -> Path:                                                                                                                                  │
 │    112         """Create a backup of the original file."""                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    113         backup_name = f"{file_path.name}.backup.{self._get_timestamp()}"                                                                                                                              │
 │    114         backup_path = self.backup_dir / backup_name                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    115         backup_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                             │
 │    116         return backup_path                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    117                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    118     def _restore_backup(self, file_path: Path, backup_path: Path) -> bool:                                                                                                                            │
 │    119         """Restore file from backup."""                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    120         try:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    121             if backup_path.exists():                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    122                 content = backup_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                     │
 │    123                 file_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                       │
 │    124             return True                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    125         except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    126             return False                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    127                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    128     def _patch_python_file(self, file_path: Path, content: str,                                                                                                                                       │
 │    129                           patch_operations: List[Dict[str, Any]], dry_run: bool) -> PatchResult:                                                                                                      │
 │    130         """Apply patches to a Python file using AST."""                                                                                                                                               │
 │    131         try:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    132             # Parse AST                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    133             tree = ast.parse(content)                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    134                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    135             # Apply transformations                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    136             transformer = self._create_python_transformer(patch_operations)                                                                                                                           │
 │    137             new_tree = transformer.visit(tree)                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    138             ast.fix_missing_locations(new_tree)                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    139                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    140             # Convert back to source                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    141             import astor                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    142             patched_content = astor.to_source(new_tree)                                                                                                                                               │
 │    143                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    144             # Check if changes were made                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    145             changes_made = patched_content != content                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    146                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    147             # Write changes if not dry run                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    148             if changes_made and not dry_run:                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    149                 file_path.write_text(patched_content, encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                               │
 │    150                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    151             return PatchResult(                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    152                 success=True,                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    153                 file_path=str(file_path.relative_to(self.project_root)),                                                                                                                              │
 │    154                 changes_made=changes_made,                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    155                 original_content=content,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    156                 patched_content=patched_content,                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    157                 backup_path=str(self.backup_dir / f"{file_path.name}.backup.{self._get_timestamp()}"),                                                                                                │
 │    158                 error_message=None,                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    159                 line_changes=self._calculate_line_changes(content, patched_content)                                                                                                                   │
 │    160             )                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    161                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    162         except Exception as e:                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    163             return PatchResult(                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    164                 success=False,                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    165                 file_path=str(file_path.relative_to(self.project_root)),                                                                                                                              │
 │    166                 changes_made=False,                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    167                 original_content=content,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    168                 patched_content=content,                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    169                 backup_path=None,                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    170                 error_message=f"AST transformation failed: {str(e)}",                                                                                                                                 │
 │    171                 line_changes=[]                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    172             )                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    173                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    174     def _create_python_transformer(self, patch_operations: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> ast.NodeTransformer:                                                                                              │
 │    175         """Create a Python AST transformer for the given operations."""                                                                                                                               │
 │    176         class PythonTransformer(ast.NodeTransformer):                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    177             def __init__(self, operations: List[Dict[str, Any]]):                                                                                                                                     │
 │    178                 self.operations = operations                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    179                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    180             def visit_FunctionDef(self, node):                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    181                 # Apply function-specific operations                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    182                 for op in self.operations:                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    183                     if op.get("type") == "add_parameter" and op.get("target_function") == node.name:                                                                                                  │
 │    184                         # Add parameter to function                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    185                         param_name = op.get("parameter_name")                                                                                                                                         │
 │    186                         default_value = op.get("default_value")                                                                                                                                       │
 │    187                         if param_name:                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    188                             # Add parameter to args                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    189                             arg = ast.arg(arg=param_name, annotation=None)                                                                                                                            │
 │    190                             node.args.args.append(arg)                                                                                                                                                │
 │    191                             if default_value is not None:                                                                                                                                             │
 │    192                                 # Add default value                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    193                                 node.args.defaults.append(ast.Constant(value=default_value))                                                                                                          │
 │    194                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    195                 return self.generic_visit(node)                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    196                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    197             def visit_Import(self, node):                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    198                 # Apply import operations                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    199                 for op in self.operations:                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    200                     if op.get("type") == "add_import":                                                                                                                                                │
 │    201                         module = op.get("module")                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    202                         if module:                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    203                             # Add new import                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    204                             pass  # Complex to implement without breaking existing structure                                                                                                          │
 │    205                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    206                 return self.generic_visit(node)                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    207                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    208         return PythonTransformer(patch_operations)                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    209                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    210     def _patch_typescript_file(self, file_path: Path, content: str,                                                                                                                                   │
 │    211                               patch_operations: List[Dict[str, Any]], dry_run: bool) -> PatchResult:                                                                                                  │
 │    212         """Apply patches to a TypeScript file using ts-morph."""                                                                                                                                      │
 │    213         try:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    214             # For now, use simple text-based patching for TypeScript                                                                                                                                  │
 │    215             # In a real implementation, we would use ts-morph via Node.js                                                                                                                             │
 │    216                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    217             patched_content = content                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    218             changes_made = False                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    219                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    220             # Apply simple text-based operations                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    221             for op in patch_operations:                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    222                 op_type = op.get("type")                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    223                 if op_type == "add_import":                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    224                     module = op.get("module")                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    225                     if module and f"from '{module}'" not in patched_content:                                                                                                                          │
 │    226                         # Add import at the top                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    227                         lines = patched_content.split('\n')                                                                                                                                           │
 │    228                         lines.insert(0, f"import {{ }} from '{module}';")                                                                                                                             │
 │    229                         patched_content = '\n'.join(lines)                                                                                                                                            │
 │    230                         changes_made = True                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    231                 elif op_type == "add_function":                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    232                     function_name = op.get("function_name")                                                                                                                                           │
 │    233                     if function_name and f"function {function_name}" not in patched_content:                                                                                                          │
 │    234                         # Add function at the end                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    235                         function_body = op.get("body", "// TODO: Implement function")                                                                                                                 │
 │    236                         patched_content += f"\n\nfunction {function_name}() {{\n{function_body}\n}}\n"                                                                                                │
 │    237                         changes_made = True                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    238                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    239             # Check if changes were made                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    240             changes_made = changes_made or (patched_content != content)                                                                                                                               │
 │    241                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    242             # Write changes if not dry run                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    243             if changes_made and not dry_run:                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    244                 file_path.write_text(patched_content, encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                               │
 │    245                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    246             return PatchResult(                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    247                 success=True,                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    248                 file_path=str(file_path.relative_to(self.project_root)),                                                                                                                              │
 │    249                 changes_made=changes_made,                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    250                 original_content=content,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    251                 patched_content=patched_content,                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    252                 backup_path=str(self.backup_dir / f"{file_path.name}.backup.{self._get_timestamp()}"),                                                                                                │
 │    253                 error_message=None,                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    254                 line_changes=self._calculate_line_changes(content, patched_content)                                                                                                                   │
 │    255             )                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    256                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    257         except Exception as e:                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    258             return PatchResult(                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    259                 success=False,                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    260                 file_path=str(file_path.relative_to(self.project_root)),                                                                                                                              │
 │    261                 changes_made=False,                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    262                 original_content=content,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    263                 patched_content=content,                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    264                 backup_path=None,                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    265                 error_message=f"TypeScript transformation failed: {str(e)}",                                                                                                                          │
 │    266                 line_changes=[]                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    267             )                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    268                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    269     def _calculate_line_changes(self, original: str, patched: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:                                                                                                           │
 │    270         """Calculate line-by-line changes between original and patched content."""                                                                                                                    │
 │    271         original_lines = original.split('\n')                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    272         patched_lines = patched.split('\n')                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    273                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    274         changes = []                                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    275                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    276         # Simple diff algorithm                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    277         max_len = max(len(original_lines), len(patched_lines))                                                                                                                                        │
 │    278         for i in range(max_len):                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    279             orig_line = original_lines[i] if i < len(original_lines) else None                                                                                                                        │
 │    280             patch_line = patched_lines[i] if i < len(patched_lines) else None                                                                                                                         │
 │    281                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    282             if orig_line != patch_line:                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    283                 change_type = "modified"                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    284                 if orig_line is None:                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    285                     change_type = "added"                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    286                 elif patch_line is None:                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    287                     change_type = "deleted"                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    288                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    289                 changes.append({                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    290                     "line_number": i + 1,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    291                     "type": change_type,                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    292                     "original": orig_line,                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    293                     "patched": patch_line                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    294                 })                                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    295                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    296         return changes                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    297                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    298     def _get_timestamp(self) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    299         """Get current timestamp."""                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    300         from datetime import datetime, timezone                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    301         return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")                                                                                                                                   │
 │    302                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    303     def rollback_last_patch(self, backup_path: str) -> bool:                                                                                                                                          │
 │    304         """Rollback the last patch using the backup."""                                                                                                                                               │
 │    305         try:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    306             backup_file = Path(backup_path)                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    307             if backup_file.exists():                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    308                 # Extract original file path from backup name                                                                                                                                         │
 │    309                 backup_name = backup_file.name                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    310                 if ".backup." in backup_name:                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    311                     original_file_name = backup_name.split(".backup.")[0]                                                                                                                             │
 │    312                     original_file = self.project_root / original_file_name                                                                                                                            │
 │    313                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    314                     # Restore content                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    315                     content = backup_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                 │
 │    316                     original_file.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                               │
 │    317                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    318                     return True                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    319             return False                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    320         except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    321             return False                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    322                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    323                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    324 def create_ast_patcher(project_root: str = ".", backup_dir: str = "data/backups") -> ASTPatcher:                                                                                                      │
 │    325     """Factory function to create an ASTPatcher instance."""                                                                                                                                          │
 │    326     return ASTPatcher(project_root, backup_dir)                                                                                                                                                       │

 │    377     def _generate_diff_comments(self, file_path: str, diff_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:                                                                                                     │
 │    378         """Generate comments based on diff content."""                                                                                                                                                │
 │    379         comments = []                                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    380                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    381         # Simple line-by-line analysis                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    382         lines = diff_content.split('\n')                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    383         for i, line in enumerate(lines):                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    384             if line.startswith('+') and len(line) > 1:                                                                                                                                                │
 │    385                 # Added line - check for common issues                                                                                                                                                │
 │    386                 content = line[1:].strip()                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    387                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    388                 # Check for hardcoded secrets                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    389                 if "api_key" in content.lower() or "secret" in content.lower():                                                                                                                       │
 │    390                     comments.append({                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    391                         "line": i + 1,                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    392                         "type": "security",                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    393                         "severity": "critical",                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    394                         "message": "Possible hardcoded secret detected",                                                                                                                              │
 │    395                         "suggestion": "Use environment variables or secure configuration"                                                                                                             │
 │    396                     })                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    397                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    398                 # Check for console.log calls                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    399                 elif "console.log" in content:                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    400                     comments.append({                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    401                         "line": i + 1,                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    402                         "type": "maintainability",                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    403                         "severity": "medium",                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    404                         "message": "Console log detected",                                                                                                                                            │
 │    405                         "suggestion": "Remove or replace with proper logging"                                                                                                                         │
 │    406                     })                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    407                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    408                 # Check for TODO comments                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    409                 elif "TODO" in content:                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    410                     comments.append({                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    411                         "line": i + 1,                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    412                         "type": "maintainability",                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    413                         "severity": "low",                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    414                         "message": "TODO comment detected",                                                                                                                                           │
 │    415                         "suggestion": "Create proper issue or tracking item"                                                                                                                          │
 │    416                     })                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    417                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    418         return comments                                                                                                                                                                               │

 │    420     def _generate_summary(self, linter_results: List[LinterResult],                                                                                                                                   │
 │    421                           security_results: List[SecurityResult]) -> Dict[str, Any]:                                                                                                                  │
 │    422         """Generate overall summary of code review."""                                                                                                                                                │
 │    423         total_errors = sum(result.error_count for result in linter_results)                                                                                                                           │
 │    424         total_warnings = sum(result.warning_count for result in linter_results)                                                                                                                       │
 │    425         total_critical = sum(result.critical_count for result in security_results)                                                                                                                    │
 │    426         total_high = sum(result.high_count for result in security_results)                                                                                                                            │
 │    427         total_medium = sum(result.medium_count for result in security_results)                                                                                                                        │
 │    428                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    429         # Determine overall status                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    430         status = "approved"                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    431         if total_critical > 0 or total_high > 0:                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    432             status = "rejected"                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    433         elif total_errors > 0:                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    434             status = "needs_revision"                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    435         elif total_warnings > 0 or total_medium > 0:                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    436             status = "approved_with_comments"                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    437                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    438         return {                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    439             "status": status,                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    440             "total_errors": total_errors,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    441             "total_warnings": total_warnings,                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    442             "total_critical": total_critical,                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    443             "total_high": total_high,                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    444             "total_medium": total_medium,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    445             "total_low": 0,  # Placeholder                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    446             "linter_results": len(linter_results),                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    447             "security_results": len(security_results)                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    448         }                                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    449                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    450     def _get_current_timestamp(self) -> str:                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    451         """Get current timestamp in ISO format."""                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    452         from datetime import datetime, timezone                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    453         return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()                                                                                                                                                 │

 │    455     def generate_review_report(self, review: CodeReview) -> str:                                                                                                                                      │
 │    456         """Generate a human-readable review report."""                                                                                                                                                │
 │    457         output = []                                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    458         output.append(f"# Code Review Report for {review.file_path}")                                                                                                                                 │

 │    460         output.append("")                                                                                                                                                                             │

 │    462         # Summary                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    463         output.append("## Summary")                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    464         output.append(f"Status: {review.summary['status']}")                                                                                                                                          │
 │    465         output.append(f"Errors: {review.summary['total_errors']}")                                                                                                                                    │
 │    466         output.append(f"Warnings: {review.summary['total_warnings']}")                                                                                                                                │
 │    467         output.append(f"Critical Issues: {review.summary['total_critical']}")                                                                                                                         │
 │    468         output.append(f"High Issues: {review.summary['total_high']}")                                                                                                                                 │
 │    469         output.append(f"Medium Issues: {review.summary['total_medium']}")                                                                                                                             │
 │    470         output.append("")                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    471                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    472         # Linter Results                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    473         if review.linter_results:                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    474             output.append("## Linter Results")                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    475             for result in review.linter_results:                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    476                 output.append(f"### {result.linter}")                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    477                 output.append(f"Success: {result.success}")                                                                                                                                           │
 │    478                 output.append(f"Issues: {len(result.issues)}")                                                                                                                                        │
 │    479                 output.append(f"Errors: {result.error_count}")                                                                                                                                        │
 │    480                 output.append(f"Warnings: {result.warning_count}")                                                                                                                                    │
 │    481                 if result.issues:                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    482                     output.append("Issues:")                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    483                     for issue in result.issues[:5]:  # Limit to first 5                                                                                                                               │
 │    484                         output.append(f"  - {issue}")                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    485                 output.append("")                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    486                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    487         # Security Results                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    488         if review.security_results:                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    489             output.append("## Security Results")                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    490             for result in review.security_results:                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    491                 output.append(f"### {result.tool}")                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    492                 output.append(f"Success: {result.success}")                                                                                                                                           │
 │    493                 output.append(f"Vulnerabilities: {len(result.vulnerabilities)}")                                                                                                                      │
 │    494                 output.append(f"Critical: {result.critical_count}")                                                                                                                                   │
 │    495                 output.append(f"High: {result.high_count}")                                                                                                                                           │
 │    496                 output.append(f"Medium: {result.medium_count}")                                                                                                                                       │
 │    497                 if result.vulnerabilities:                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    498                     output.append("Vulnerabilities:")                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    499                     for vuln in result.vulnerabilities[:5]:  # Limit to first 5                                                                                                                       │
 │    500                         output.append(f"  - {vuln}")                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    501                 output.append("")                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    502                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    503         # Diff Comments                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    504         if review.diff_aware_comments:                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    505             output.append("## Diff-Aware Comments")                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    506             for comment in review.diff_aware_comments:                                                                                                                                                │
 │    507                 output.append(f"### Line {comment.get('line', '?')}: {comment.get('message', '')}")                                                                                                   │
 │    508                 output.append(f"Severity: {comment.get('severity', 'low')}")                                                                                                                          │
 │    509                 output.append(f"Suggestion: {comment.get('suggestion', 'No suggestion')}")                                                                                                            │
 │    510                 output.append("")                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    511                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    512         return "\n".join(output)                                                                                                                                                                      │
