 │    258     def _extract_components_from_file(self, file_path: Path) -> List[ReactComponent]:                                                                                                                 │
 │    259         """Extract React components from a file."""                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    260         components = []                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    261                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    262         try:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    263             content = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                           │
 │    264                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    265             # Simple regex-based extraction for now                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    266             # In a real implementation, you would use a proper AST parser for JS/TS                                                                                                                   │
 │    267                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    268             # Look for component definitions                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    269             import re                                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    270                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    271             # Look for function components                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    272             function_pattern = r"function\s+(\w+)\s*\("                                                                                                                                               │
 │    273             function_matches = re.findall(function_pattern, content)                                                                                                                                  │
 │    274                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    275             # Look for arrow function components                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    276             arrow_pattern = r"const\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*\([^)]*\)\s*=>"                                                                                                                                     │
 │    277             arrow_matches = re.findall(arrow_pattern, content)                                                                                                                                        │
 │    278                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    279             # Combine all component names                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    280             component_names = list(set(function_matches + arrow_matches))                                                                                                                             │
 │    281                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    282             # Extract basic information for each component                                                                                                                                            │
 │    283             for component_name in component_names:                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    284                 # Extract props                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    285                 props = self._extract_props(content, component_name)                                                                                                                                  │
 │    286                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    287                 # Extract state variables                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    288                 state_vars = self._extract_state_variables(content)                                                                                                                                   │
 │    289                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    290                 # Extract hooks                                                                                                                                                                       │

 │    313     def _extract_props(self, content: str, component_name: str) -> List[str]:                                                                                                                         │
 │    314         """Extract props from component definition."""                                                                                                                                                │
 │    315         props = []                                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    316                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    317         # Look for destructuring patterns                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    318         import re                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    319         destructuring_pattern = rf"{component_name}\s*{{([^}}]+)}}"                                                                                                                                   │
 │    320         matches = re.findall(destructuring_pattern, content)                                                                                                                                          │
 │    321                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    322         for match in matches:                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    323             # Split by commas and clean up                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    324             prop_list = [prop.strip() for prop in match.split(',')]                                                                                                                                   │
 │    325             props.extend([prop.split(':')[0].strip() for prop in prop_list if prop.strip()])                                                                                                          │
 │    326                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    327         return list(set(props))                                                                                                                                                                       │

 │    344     def _extract_hooks(self, content: str) -> List[str]:                                                                                                                                              │
 │    345         """Extract React hooks used in the component."""                                                                                                                                              │
 │    346         hooks = []                                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    347                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    348         # Look for common React hooks                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    349         common_hooks = [                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    350             "useState", "useEffect", "useContext", "useReducer",                                                                                                                                      │
 │    351             "useCallback", "useMemo", "useRef", "useImperativeHandle",                                                                                                                                │
 │    352             "useLayoutEffect", "useDebugValue"                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    353         ]                                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    354                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    355         for hook in common_hooks:                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    356             if hook in content:                                                                                                                                                                       │

 │    361     def _extract_api_calls(self, content: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:                                                                                                                               │
 │    362         """Extract API calls from the component."""                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    363         api_calls = []                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    364                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    365         # Look for common API call patterns                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    366         import re                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    367                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    368         # Look for fetch calls                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    369         fetch_pattern = r"fetch\(['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]"                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    370         fetch_matches = re.findall(fetch_pattern, content)                                                                                                                                            │
 │    371                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    372         for match in fetch_matches:                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    373             api_calls.append({                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    374                 "method": "FETCH",                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    375                 "url": match,                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    376                 "line": self._find_line_number(content, match)                                                                                                                                        │
 │    377             })                                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    378                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    379         # Look for axios calls                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    380         axios_pattern = r"axios\.(get|post|put|delete)\(['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]"                                                                                                                          │
 │    381         axios_matches = re.findall(axios_pattern, content)                                                                                                                                            │
 │    382                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    383         for method, url in axios_matches:                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    384             api_calls.append({                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    385                 "method": method.upper(),                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    386                 "url": url,                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    387                 "line": self._find_line_number(content, url)                                                                                                                                          │
 │    388             })                                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    389                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    390         # Look for apiGet/apiPost calls (custom API client)                                                                                                                                           │
 │    391         custom_pattern = r"api(Get|Post|Put|Delete)\(['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]"                                                                                                                             │
 │    392         custom_matches = re.findall(custom_pattern, content)                                                                                                                                          │
 │    393                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    394         for method, url in custom_matches:                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    395             api_calls.append({                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    396                 "method": method.upper(),                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    397                 "url": url,                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    398                 "line": self._find_line_number(content, url)                                                                                                                                          │
 │    399             })                                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    400                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    401         return api_calls                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    402                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    403     def _extract_dependencies(self, content: str) -> List[str]:                                                                                                                                       │
 │    404         """Extract import dependencies."""                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    405         dependencies = []                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    406                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    407         # Look for import statements                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    408         import re                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    409         import_pattern = r"from\s+['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]"                                                                                                                                                │
 │    410         matches = re.findall(import_pattern, content)                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    411                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    412         for match in matches:                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    413             # Filter out relative imports and node_modules                                                                                                                                            │
 │    414             if not match.startswith('.') and 'node_modules' not in match:                                                                                                                             │
 │    415                 dependencies.append(match)                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    416                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    417         return list(set(dependencies))                                                                                                                                                                │

 │    419     def _map_python_services(self) -> List[PythonService]:                                                                                                                                            │
 │    420         """Map Python services from the repository."""                                                                                                                                                │
 │    421         services = []                                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    422                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    423         # Look for Python service files                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    424         service_files = []                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    425         if (self.python_src / "api" / "services").exists():                                                                                                                                           │
 │    426             for file in (self.python_src / "api" / "services").rglob("*.py"):                                                                                                                         │
 │    427                 if file.is_file():                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    428                     service_files.append(file)                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    429                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    430         # Extract services from each file                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    431         for file_path in service_files:                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    432             try:                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    433                 services.extend(self._extract_services_from_file(file_path))                                                                                                                          │
 │    434             except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    435                 continue                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    436                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    437         return services                                                                                                                                                                               │

 │    439     def _extract_services_from_file(self, file_path: Path) -> List[PythonService]:                                                                                                                    │
 │    440         """Extract Python services from a file."""                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    441         services = []                                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    442                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    443         try:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    444             content = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                           │
 │    445             tree = ast.parse(content)                                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    446                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    447             # Extract service name from file name                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    448             service_name = file_path.stem                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    449                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    450             # Extract functions                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    451             functions = []                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    452             for node in ast.walk(tree):                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    453                 if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    454                     functions.append(node.name)                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    455                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    456             # Extract classes                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    457             classes = []                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    458             for node in ast.walk(tree):                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    459                 if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    460                     classes.append(node.name)                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    461                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    462             # Extract imports                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    463             imports = []                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    464             for node in ast.walk(tree):                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    465                 if isinstance(node, ast.Import):                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    466                     for alias in node.names:                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    467                         imports.append(alias.name)                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    468                 elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):                                                                                                                                                │
 │    469                     if node.module:                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    470                         imports.append(node.module)                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    471                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    472             # Extract endpoints (FastAPI routes)                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    473             endpoints = self._extract_endpoints_from_file(file_path)                                                                                                                                  │
 │    474                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    475             services.append(PythonService(                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    476                 name=service_name,                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    477                 file_path=str(file_path.relative_to(self.project_root)),                                                                                                                              │
 │    478                 functions=functions,                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    479                 classes=classes,                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    480                 imports=imports,                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    481                 endpoints=endpoints                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    482             ))                                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    483         except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    484             pass                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    485                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    486         return services                                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    487                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    488     def _find_line_number(self, content: str, pattern: str) -> int:                                                                                                                                   │
 │    489         """Find line number of a pattern in content."""                                                                                                                                               │
 │    490         lines = content.split('\n')                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    491         for i, line in enumerate(lines):                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    492             if pattern in line:                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    493                 return i + 1                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    494         return 1                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    495                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    496     def _get_current_timestamp(self) -> str:                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    497         """Get current timestamp in ISO format."""                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    498         from datetime import datetime, timezone                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    499         return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()                                                                                                                                                 │

 │    501     def save_repo_map(self, repo_map: RepoMap, output_path: str = "data/repo_map.json") -> Path:                                                                                                      │
 │    502         """Save the repository map to a JSON file."""                                                                                                                                                 │
 │    503         output_file = Path(output_path)                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    504         output_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                                                                                                                                         │
 │    505                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    506         # Convert to dictionary                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    507         def serialize(obj):                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    508             if hasattr(obj, '__dict__'):                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    509                 return obj.__dict__                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    510             elif isinstance(obj, list):                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    511                 return [serialize(item) for item in obj]                                                                                                                                              │
 │    512             elif isinstance(obj, dict):                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    513                 return {key: serialize(value) for key, value in obj.items()}                                                                                                                          │
 │    514             else:                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    515                 return obj                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    516                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    517         data = serialize(repo_map)                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    518         output_file.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                      │
 │    519         return output_file                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    520                                                                                                                                                                                                       │

 │    118     def _provide_real_time_guidance(self, line: str) -> None:                                                                                                                                         │
 │    119         """Provide real-time guidance based on agent output."""                                                                                                                                       │
 │    120         # Look for common patterns that need mentoring                                                                                                                                                │
 │    121         if "error" in line.lower() or "failed" in line.lower():                                                                                                                                       │
 │    122             self._log("💡 Mentor Tip: Check error details and consider fallback strategies")                                                                                                          │
 │    123                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    124         elif "warning" in line.lower():                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    125             self._log("💡 Mentor Tip: Address warnings to improve code quality")                                                                                                                      │
 │    126                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    127         elif "loading" in line.lower():                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    128             self._log("💡 Mentor Tip: Loading operations can be optimized with caching")                                                                                                              │
 │    129                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    130         elif "processing" in line.lower():                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    131             self._log("💡 Mentor Tip: Consider progress indicators for long operations")                                                                                                              │
 │    132                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    133         elif "saving" in line.lower():                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    134             self._log("💡 Mentor Tip: Always validate data before saving")                                                                                                                            │
