 │    136     def _provide_post_session_feedback(self, results: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:                                                                                                                        │
 │    137         """Provide feedback after session completion."""                                                                                                                                              │
 │    138         success = results.get("success", False)                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    139         duration = results.get("duration", 0)                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    140                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    141         if success:                                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    142             self._log("✅ Excellent work! The agent completed its task successfully.")                                                                                                                │
 │    143                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    144             if duration < 30:                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    145                 self._log("⚡ Impressive speed! The agent is performing efficiently.")                                                                                                                │
 │    146             elif duration > 120:                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    147                 self._log("🐢 The agent took longer than expected. Consider optimization opportunities.")                                                                                             │
 │    148         else:                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    149             error = results.get("error", "Unknown error")                                                                                                                                             │
 │    150             self._log(f"❌ The agent encountered an issue: {error}")                                                                                                                                  │
 │    151             self._log("💡 Mentor Tip: Review the error, check inputs, and try again with adjustments.")                                                                                               │
 │    152                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    153     def _analyze_results(self, stdout_lines: list[str], stderr_lines: list[str],                                                                                                                      │
 │    154                         return_code: int, duration: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:                                                                                                                         │
 │    155         """Analyze agent execution results."""                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    156         # Parse output for key information                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    157         success = return_code == 0                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    158         error_messages = [line for line in stderr_lines if line.strip()]                                                                                                                              │
 │    159         output_messages = [line for line in stdout_lines if line.strip()]                                                                                                                             │
 │    160                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    161         # Look for JSON results in output                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    162         results_data = None                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    163         for line in reversed(output_messages):                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    164             if line.startswith('{') and line.endswith('}'):                                                                                                                                           │
 │    165                 try:                                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    166                     results_data = json.loads(line)                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    167                     break                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    168                 except json.JSONDecodeError:                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    169                     continue                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    170                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    171         return {                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    172             "success": success,                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    173             "return_code": return_code,                                                                                                                                                               │
 │    174             "duration": duration,                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    175             "stdout_lines": len(stdout_lines),                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    176             "stderr_lines": len(stderr_lines),                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    177             "error_messages": error_messages[:5],  # Limit to first 5 errors                                                                                                                          │
 │    178             "output_messages": output_messages[-10:],  # Limit to last 10 outputs                                                                                                                     │
 │    179             "results_data": results_data,                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    180             "session_id": self.session_id,                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    181             "timestamp": self._get_timestamp()                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    182         }                                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    183                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    184     def train_agent(self, curriculum_phase: str, tasks: list[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:                                                                                                      │
 │    185         """                                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    186         Train the agent through a specific curriculum phase.                                                                                                                                          │
 │    187                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    188         Args:                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    189             curriculum_phase: Name of the training phase                                                                                                                                              │
 │    190             tasks: List of tasks to execute with goals and expected outcomes                                                                                                                          │
 │    191                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    192         Returns:                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    193             Training results with success metrics                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    194         """                                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    195         self._log(f"🎓 Starting training phase: {curriculum_phase}")                                                                                                                                  │
 │    196         self._log(f"📋 Tasks to complete: {len(tasks)}")                                                                                                                                              │
 │    197                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    198         results = {                                                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    199             "phase": curriculum_phase,                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    200             "tasks_total": len(tasks),                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    201             "tasks_completed": 0,                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    202             "tasks_failed": 0,                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    203             "task_results": [],                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    204             "start_time": self._get_timestamp(),                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    205             "duration": 0                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    206         }                                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    207                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    208         start_time = time.time()                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    209                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    210         for i, task in enumerate(tasks):                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    211             self._log(f"📝 Task {i+1}/{len(tasks)}: {task.get('goal', 'Unnamed task')}")                                                                                                              │
 │    212                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    213             # Launch agent for this task                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    214             task_result = self.launch_agent(                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    215                 goal=task.get("goal", ""),                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    216                 mode=task.get("mode", "full"),                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    217                 complexity=task.get("complexity", "medium")                                                                                                                                           │
 │    218             )                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    219                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    220             # Record task result                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    221             task_result["task_index"] = i                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    222             task_result["expected_outcome"] = task.get("expected_outcome", "success")                                                                                                                 │
 │    223             results["task_results"].append(task_result)                                                                                                                                               │
 │    224                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    225             # Update counters                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    226             if task_result.get("success", False):                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    227                 results["tasks_completed"] += 1                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    228                 self._log(f"✅ Task {i+1} completed successfully")                                                                                                                                    │
 │    229             else:                                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    230                 results["tasks_failed"] += 1                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    231                 self._log(f"❌ Task {i+1} failed")                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    232                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    233         results["duration"] = time.time() - start_time                                                                                                                                                │
 │    234         results["end_time"] = self._get_timestamp()                                                                                                                                                   │
 │    235         results["success_rate"] = results["tasks_completed"] / len(tasks) if tasks else 0                                                                                                             │
 │    236                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    237         self._log(f"🏁 Training phase completed: {results['tasks_completed']}/{len(tasks)} tasks successful")                                                                                         │
 │    238         self._log(f"📈 Success rate: {results['success_rate']:.2%}")                                                                                                                                  │
 │    239                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    240         return results                                                                                                                                                                                │
 │    241                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    242     def evaluate_agent_progress(self, previous_sessions: list[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:                                                                                                     │
 │    243         """                                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    244         Evaluate agent progress based on previous sessions.                                                                                                                                           │
 │    245                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    246         Args:                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    247             previous_sessions: List of previous session results                                                                                                                                       │
 │    248                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    249         Returns:                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    250             Progress evaluation with recommendations                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    251         """                                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    252         if not previous_sessions:                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    253             return {"evaluation": "No previous sessions to evaluate", "recommendations": []}                                                                                                          │
 │    254                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    255         # Analyze trends                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    256         success_rates = [session.get("success_rate", 0) for session in previous_sessions]                                                                                                             │
 │    257         durations = [session.get("duration", 0) for session in previous_sessions]                                                                                                                     │
 │    258                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    259         # Calculate trends                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    260         avg_success_rate = sum(success_rates) / len(success_rates) if success_rates else 0                                                                                                            │
 │    261         avg_duration = sum(durations) / len(durations) if durations else 0                                                                                                                            │
 │    262                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    263         # Check for improvement                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    264         recent_success_rate = success_rates[-1] if success_rates else 0                                                                                                                               │
 │    265         improvement = recent_success_rate - (success_rates[0] if len(success_rates) > 1 else 0)                                                                                                       │
 │    266                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    267         # Generate recommendations                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    268         recommendations = []                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    269         if improvement > 0.1:                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    270             recommendations.append("🎉 Excellent improvement! Continue current approach.")                                                                                                            │
 │    271         elif improvement < -0.1:                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    272             recommendations.append("⚠️  Performance declined. Review recent changes and adjust approach.)                                                                                            │
 │    273         else:                                                                                                                                                                                         │
 │    274             recommendations.append("📊 Steady performance. Look for optimization opportunities.")                                                                                                     │
 │    275                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    276         if avg_success_rate < 0.8:                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    277             recommendations.append("🎯 Focus on error handling and fallback strategies.")                                                                                                             │
 │    278                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    279         if avg_duration > 120:                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    280             recommendations.append("⚡ Consider optimizing slow operations with caching or parallelization.")                                                                                         │
 │    281                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    282         return {                                                                                                                                                                                      │
 │    283             "evaluation": {                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    284                 "average_success_rate": avg_success_rate,                                                                                                                                             │
 │    285                 "average_duration": avg_duration,                                                                                                                                                     │
 │    286                 "recent_improvement": improvement,                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    287                 "sessions_analyzed": len(previous_sessions)                                                                                                                                           │
 │    288             },                                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    289             "recommendations": recommendations,                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    290             "timestamp": self._get_timestamp()                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    291         }                                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    292                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    293     def _log(self, message: str) -> None:                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    294         """Log a message to both console and session log."""                                                                                                                                          │
 │    295         timestamp = self._get_timestamp()                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    296         log_entry = f"[{timestamp}] {message}"                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    297                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    298         # Print to console                                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    299         print(log_entry)                                                                                                                                                                              │
 │    300                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    301         # Write to session log                                                                                                                                                                        │
 │    302         try:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
 │    303             with open(self.session_log, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:                                                                                                                                  │
 │    304                 f.write(log_entry + "\n")                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    305         except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    306             pass  # Ignore logging errors                                                                                                                                                             │
 │    307                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    308     def _generate_session_id(self) -> str:                                                                                                                                                            │
 │    309         """Generate a unique session ID."""                                                                                                                                                           │
 │    310         return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")                                                                                                                                   │
 │    311                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
 │    312     def _get_timestamp(self) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                  │
 │    313         """Get current timestamp in ISO format."""                                                                                                                                                    │
 │    314         return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()                                                                                                                                                 │
